(a) the anterior digastric muscles undergo a significant increase in size during distraction osteogenesis; (b) the anterior digastic muscles exhibit a marked increase in type 2B fibers during distraction osteogenesis, and (c) the anterior digatic muscles undergo a significant change in fiber type composition during distraction osteogenesis.
